info.title: outlook-cli
info.description: CLI tool for Outlook: calendar sync, email, calendar events, and contacts

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: outlook — Outlook CLI for email, calendar, contacts and calendar sync

commands.name: sync
commands.description: Sync events from one calendar to another

options.name: --source
options.description: Source account name (sync FROM this calendar)

options.name: --target
options.description: Target account name (sync TO this calendar)

options.name: --to
options.description: End date (yyyy-MM-dd). Defaults to today + 90 days.

options.name: --mode
options.description: Sync mode: 'block' (anonymous busy blocks) or 'copy' (copies title and description). [default: block]

options.name: --outside-hours
options.description: Only sync events outside working hours (07:00-18:00). [default: False]

commands.name: purge
commands.description: Delete all synced/blocked events created by outlook sync from a calendar

options.name: --account
options.description: Account to purge synced events from

options.name: --from
options.description: Start date (yyyy-MM-dd). Defaults to 2 years ago.

options.name: --to
options.description: End date (yyyy-MM-dd). Defaults to 2 years from now.

options.name: --folder
options.description: Folder: inbox, sent, drafts, outbox (default: inbox)

options.name: --account
options.description: Account display name (omit for all accounts)

commands.name: get
commands.description: Get full email details including body

options.name: --account
options.description: Account display name (omit for all accounts)

options.name: --account
options.description: Account display name to send from

commands.name: list
commands.description: List calendar events in a date range

options.name: --include-blocked
options.description: Include synced/blocked events created by outlook sync [default: False]

commands.name: get
commands.description: Get full event details including body and attendees

options.name: --end-date
options.description: End date yyyy-MM-dd (default: same as start)

options.name: --end-time
options.description: End time HH:mm (default: 30 min after start)

options.name: --meeting
options.description: Create as meeting with attendees [default: False]

commands.name: free-slots
commands.description: Find available time slots for scheduling

options.name: --to
options.description: End date yyyy-MM-dd (default: 7 days from start)

commands.name: attendees
commands.description: Get attendee response status for a meeting

commands.name: respond
commands.description: Respond to a meeting invitation (accept, decline, or tentative)

arguments.name: QUERY
arguments.description: Search by name, email, or company

arguments.name: ID
arguments.description: Contact ID (EntryID from list or search)
